title: The saved stroke button stays on screen beside a long layers list
goal: On an icon with four or more layers and the Styles shelf open, the Appearance section is squeezed so far that the one click button for a saved stroke needs a scroll first, in a window 900 points tall. A person building a glyph should reach it without scrolling.
notes: Seen in queue/audits/2026-11-07-saved-stroke-7-width-by-hand-sc.png: with four layers Line is the last visible row. Reproduce: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/a-glyph-takes-the-saved-stroke-walk.json --no-build, picture 11-a-width-set-by-hand-wins-sc.png. The Layers list takes the room, so moving the row further cannot fix it. The row is already directly under Line.
acceptance: With five layers and the Styles shelf open in a 900 point window, the Line Style row is on screen with a path picked
A walk at Next defaults claims it with expectInView on the Style control
